mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, bucket_id AS bucketId, storage_id AS storageId, object_key AS objectKey, file_name AS fileName, file_ext AS fileExt, content_type AS contentType, file_size AS fileSize, visibility, biz_type AS bizType, version_no AS versionNo, status, storage_path AS storagePath, upload_mode AS uploadMode, target_dir AS targetDir, CONCAT('/api/file/raw-download/', object_key) AS publicUrl, remark FROM file_object WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
